verdict.rationale: Fireworks' batch inference guide documents asynchronous processing of large request volumes at an explicit 50% discount off Serverless per-token prices. That covers both the async batch capability and the documented discount versus real-time pricing. Missing for 10: details of the job submission workflow (input file format, job creation and status endpoints, completion window), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the batch discount.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: Process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% off Serverless per-token prices.
